candidates.source_description: Wrangel Island sits right above Russia and Alaska. The Americans, British, and Canadians all tried to claim it in the 1920s by sending settlers there to live in the freezing ice. But in 1926, the Soviet Union realized it was technically undefended. They sent a heavily armed icebreaker, arrested the American settlers, confiscated their research, and simply kept the island.
